Frame the 3‑year plan as “Defend & Deepen Core Segments” — concentrate resources where we already win, use product differentiation to drive retention/expansion, and scale go‑to‑market for profitability. 
Prioritize 1–2 highest-ARPU core segments (clear ICPs, bespoke packaging, targeted sales motions) with segment-level revenue and margin targets. 
Make retention and advocacy a leading KPI set: invest in customer success playbooks, predictive health scoring, NPS-driven improvement sprints, and structured expansion motions to lift NRR. 
Differentiate the product by delivering a focused set of AI‑assisted workflows and 3–4 deep integrations/APIs that solve high‑value customer jobs and can be marketed as defensible capabilities. 
Lift margins and execution velocity by simplifying pricing (value‑based/term commitments), automating scalable channels (self‑serve + inside sales), and assigning 3–5 measurable milestones per theme for quarterly pressure‑testing.
